title: "About"

I am a **quantitative sociologist and mixed-methods researcher** who recently completed an MSc in Sociology, Culture and Society at KU Leuven. My research focuses on **discrimination, social inequality, migration, and intergroup relations**, with particular interest in how social experiences and institutional contexts shape attitudes and unequal outcomes.

My work combines survey research and statistical modelling with computational and qualitative approaches. In my master’s thesis, I used logistic and ordinal regression, interaction analysis, model diagnostics, and sensitivity analyses to examine adolescents’ acceptance of ethnic and religious discrimination. My other projects have involved machine learning, computational text analysis, clustering, and web scraping.

## Research interests

- Discrimination and social inequality
- Intergroup contact and relations
- Migration and migrant incorporation
- Attitudes, norms, and perceptions of fairness
- Quantitative and mixed-methods research

## Education

**MSc Sociology, Culture and Society**  
KU Leuven, 2026

My master’s thesis, *Acceptance of Ethnic and Religious Discrimination among Adolescents*, examined how intergroup contact, perceived and vicarious discrimination, and migrant background relate to adolescents’ acceptance of ethnic and religious discrimination.
